geometry: A large oval earth clearing sits within a low rounded grass rim. Exactly two chunky fallen root walls occupy the rear-left and front-right quarters, leaving a wide centre and both outer flanking gaps open. Each wall is rooted in an exposed dark soil bed. Three broad rounded trees stand behind the arena on the rear verge; their canopies never cover the fighting floor.

signatureFeature.physicalObjects: Two thick fallen root walls rise from exposed soil beside the open centre. Their bases visibly enter soil; their crowns stay below the flying combat space.
signatureFeature.activation: The resident keeps the root walls in their public starting state. Fighters affect a wall through a supported physical or plant attack.
signatureFeature.consequence: A wall can intercept a projectile or charge. A strong supported blow cracks and breaks it; a plant-capable fighter may bend an intact root within the same visible soil bed.
counterplay: Flank the root wall through the open centre.
Break it with a supported attack and pressure the newly exposed fighter.
Evade a manipulated root and attack the caster while it commits.
limits: The resident never repairs cover during a bout.
Root manipulation requires an appropriate fighter capability and an exposed soil connection.
A wall cannot instantly regrow, clip through unbroken stone or immobilize a fighter indefinitely.
visualEvidence: An attack meets the visible root wall or a root moves from its soil bed.
Bark cracks, soil shifts or the defender visibly changes direction.
The attacker exploits the actual opening with a legal strike.

resident.perch: Rear-right turf verge beside a low root stump, facing inward toward the clearing.

reset: Restore cover, water, feature phase and every displaced object to the same declared starting state before each bout.
